description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about family seating.

files.description: A Confluence page in the customer-policies space for support agents about family seating, last updated between 2026-08-20 and 2026-09-01. It must contain these sentences word for word: "Children under 12 sit next to their adult free; refund any seat fee."; "children under 12 sit with their adult for free"; "refund the child's seat fee"; "only when the child and the adult are on the same booking". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
